messages:
Ava (AE): kicking off Polaris POC — want to align day0 stakeholders, success criteria, and known enterprise blockers. propose a 60m session tomorrow 10am PT :calendar: — who needs to be on?
Rajat (SE): pls include their ML lead + infra/security. we should capture their eval prompts and target qps up front.
Maya (CS): i'll own customer success side — need clear pass/fail metrics (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, and accuracy on golden prompts).
Sam (Eng): quick question — do they require VPC peering or private deployment? that changes timeline a lot.
Ava (AE): good call. Polaris mentioned SOC2 + VPC option. i'll confirm.
Leila (SRE): if they want VPC + on-prem firewall rules, expect 2-3 weeks for network setup. also need public IP allowlist for health checks.
Tom (Finance): pricing note — if they plan sustained heavy throughput we should propose a Dedicated commit. want to know expected token volume/day.
Rajat (SE): intel from pre-call: target workload is conversational summarization (30-60 tokens output) and query reranking. QPS estimate ~30-50 burst to 200.
Maya (CS): success criteria draft: 1) p95 latency < 300ms for interactive flows, 2) cost per 1k tokens < $X (TBD), 3) rouge/accuracy on eval set within 5% of baseline.
Sam (Eng): for prompts/evals — can we get a ~200-example prompt set (golden set) and a withheld test set? i'll prepare an eval harness.
Rajat (SE): sample eval prompt snippet: ```
# Summarization prompt
System: You are a high-precision summarizer.
User: Summarize the following meeting notes into 3 bullet points, preserve named entities.
<NOTES>\n```
Rajat (SE): also recommend we run with quantized model variant for cost trial, fallback to full model for quality check.
Ava (AE): signpost for the kickoff: 1) intros & roles, 2) success metrics & eval plan, 3) infra/security checklist, 4) cadence & timeline, 5) pricing options + next steps.
Maya (CS): timeline proposal: Week0 intake + security Qs, Week1 infra prep (if VPC), Week2 model onboarding + evals, Week3 performance tuning, Week4 final decision.
Leila (SRE): blocker: customer requires HSM-backed KMS. we need their KMS vendor details asap.
Tom (Finance): to prep pricing options i need projected monthly tokens and whether embeddings are used.
Ava (AE): action items before kickoff: - Polaris to send golden prompts + security contact - Rajat to draft eval harness template - Leila to list network artifacts needed - Tom to outline Dedicated vs usage pricing tiers
Rajat (SE): i'll drop a short eval template into the thread after this.
OpsBot: Calendar invite created for "Polaris POC: Day0 sync" — 2026-03-22 10:00 PT, attendees: Ava (AE), Rajat (SE), Maya (CS), Sam (Eng), Leila (SRE), Tom (Finance), Polaris stakeholders.
Ava (AE): thanks all — if anyone can't make 10am PT, call it out and i'll move. otherwise i'll post the agenda + pre-read later today. :thumbsup:
